jobs.description:
Riot Games was established in 2006 by entrepreneurial gamers who believe that player-focused game development can result in great games. In 2009, Riot released its debut title League of Legends to critical and player acclaim. As the most played video game in the world, over 100 million play every month. Players form the foundation of our community and it’s for them that we continue to evolve and improve the League of Legends experience.
We’re looking for humble but ambitious, razor-sharp professionals who can teach us a thing or two. We promise to return the favor. Like us, you take play seriously; you’re passionate about games. We embrace those who see things differently, aren’t afraid to experiment, and who have a healthy disregard for constraints.
That's where you come in.
As
Content Producer, Wild Rift
, you will report to the Publishing creative production Lead and serve as a key pillar of production excellence within the publishing team. This role supports a broad range of content initiatives across channel, product marketing, and moment-based campaigns.
The Content Producer is expected to flex across different publishing functions, supporting evolving business priorities and creative needs. Your awareness and transparent communication will provide you with a comprehensive understanding of our campaign requirements, allowing you to advocate for their needs and ensure they are fulfilled.
You will be responsible for translating strategic goals into high-quality creative deliverables that surprise and delight our players , owning end-to-end production workflows, and managing agency partnerships to ensure scalable, efficient, and brand-consistent execution.
Core Responsibilities:
Production Excellence
Lead end-to-end production of Wild Rift publishing assets, ensuring high craft standards, efficiency, and timely delivery.
Drive structured production planning, risk management, and cross-functional alignment across internal teams.
Maintain clear documentation, content calendars, and production tracking systems to ensure operational rigor.
Agency & RFP Management
Own the RFP (Request for Proposal) process and agency onboarding. Identify, evaluate, and manage external vendors to ensure high-quality, cost-effective creative execution.
Establish strong working relationships with agency partners and hold them accountable to quality and timeline expectations.
Cross-Functional Production Execution
Own and drive the production execution of specific publishing tactics across multiple areas, including:
1st Party Channel Requests:
IAE, ASO, Featuring, and ad-hoc platform requests
Product Marketing:
Champion overviews, skin in-game trailers, feature spotlights, and gameplay updates
Event/Campaigns:
Event and tentpole support such as Smash, Worlds, and brand partnerships
Social Media Content:
Manage social vendor pitches and business/procurement processes, contribute to creative ideation, and provide end-to-end production management for social videos and posts.
Integrated Coordination:
Partner with other internal Riot departments (e.g., the Localization team, Music team) to drive specialized production needs, and collaborate with vendors utilizing project management tools to efficiently manage assets.
Required Qualifications:
Bilingual Proficiency:
Fluent in spoken and written English and Mandarin.
Production Experience:
3+ years of experience in creative production, advertising, or project management. Experience within the gaming or Riot ecosystem is a plus.
Agency Management:
Proven experience managing external vendors and driving RFP processes.
Asset & Workflow Management:
Ability to manage complex art marketing assets across multi-disciplinary teams.
Communication:
Strong, transparent communication skills with the ability to balance creative quality and stakeholder needs.
Desired Qualifications:
Gaming Passion:
Strong interest in mobile game marketing (MOBA genre preferred).
Technical Literacy:
Familiarity with Adobe Creative Suite for asset validation and Airtable or similar systems for workflow management.
Flexible Craft Coverage:
Ability to adapt and support multiple publishing functions based on team priorities.

About Anthropic
Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.
À propos du poste
En tant que responsable de compte Entreprise chez Anthropic, vous intégrerez l’équipe fondatrice en charge du déploiement de nos solutions API et SaaS de productivité, à la pointe de l’IA, à destination des organisations du secteur automobile en France. Vous favoriserez l’adoption d’une IA sûre et de pointe en concluant des accords stratégiques avec des constructeurs automobiles, des équipementiers de rang 1 et de rang 2, ainsi que des fournisseurs de solutions de mobilité. Vous mettrez à profit votre expertise en vente consultative dans le secteur automobile pour stimuler la croissance du chiffre d’affaires, tout en devenant un partenaire de confiance pour les parties prenantes du secteur automobile. Vous les accompagnerez dans l’intégration et le déploiement de l’IA, en explorant tout son potentiel dans les domaines de l’ingénierie et de la conception, des opérations de fabrication, des services de véhicules connectés et de l’après-vente. En collaboration avec les équipes GTM, Produit et Marketing, vous affinerez continuellement notre proposition de valeur, notre méthodologie de vente et notre positionnement sur le marché afin de répondre aux besoins des décideurs du secteur automobile.
Le candidat idéal est passionné par le développement de nouveaux segments de marché, par l'identification des opportunités à fort potentiel et mettre en œuvre des stratégies pour les saisir. En favorisant le déploiement des produits émergents d'Anthropic, vous aiderez les entreprises à acquérir de nouvelles capacités tout en favorisant le développement éthique de l'IA.
Responsabilités:
Développez le portefeuille clients et stimulez les revenus d’Anthropic dans le secteur automobile. Naviguez au sein d’organisations complexes du secteur automobile pour identifier les décideurs clés, les informer sur nos services et les accompagner vers le succès avec Anthropic. Vous serez responsable de l’ensemble du cycle de vente, depuis le premier contact jusqu’à la conclusion.
Concevoir et exécuter des stratégies de vente innovantes adaptées aux cycles d'approvisionnement automobiles, à la qualification des fournisseurs et aux processus budgétaires afin d'atteindre et de dépasser les objectifs de chiffre d'affaires. Analyser les paysages, les tendances et la dynamique du marché automobile pour transformer les plans stratégiques en activités et campagnes de vente ciblées
Mener l’expansion du marché en identifiant de nouveaux cas d’utilisation au sein des équipes d’ingénierie et de R&D, des fonctions de fabrication et de chaîne d’approvisionnement, des divisions véhicule connecté et logiciel, et des opérations d’après-vente. Collaborer de manière inter-fonctionnelle pour différencier nos offres destinées aux applications automobiles.

Informer les feuilles de route et les fonctionnalités des produits en recueillant les commentaires des utilisateurs et en transmettant les besoins du marché automobile.
Fournir des informations qui renforcent notre proposition de valeur pour le secteur automobile

Plus de 12 ans d'expérience en vente B2B dans le SaaS, les solutions API ou les technologies émergentes

Excellentes compétences en communication et capacité à faire des présentations avec assurance devant divers publics du secteur automobile, des ingénieurs et directeurs d’usine aux cadres supérieurs.
Connaissance approfondie des cycles d’achat du secteur automobile, des processus de décision et des principaux points de friction, y compris les longs délais liés aux programmes et les exigences de qualification des fournisseurs
Une approche stratégique et analytique pour évaluer le marché automobile, combinée à une exécution créative et tactique pour saisir les opportunités

Demonstrated ability to navigate automotive organisational structures and procurement processes, building consensus among diverse stakeholders including executives, engineering and manufacturing leadership, and IT departments

Deep understanding of automotive buying cycles, decision-making processes, and key pain points, including long programme timelines and supplier qualification requirements * A strategic, analytical approach to assessing the automotive market combined with creative, tactical execution to capture opportunities

jobs.description: When you join Verizon You want more out of a career. A place to share your ideas freely — even if they’re daring or different. Where the true you can learn, grow, and thrive. At Verizon, we power and empower how people live, work and play by connecting them to what brings them joy. We do what we love — driving innovation, creativity, and impact in the world. Our V Team is a community of people who anticipate, lead, and believe that listening is where learning begins. In crisis and in celebration, we come together — lifting our communities and building trust in how we show up, everywhere & always. Want in? Join the #VTeamLife. What you’ll be doing… We are committed to providing the highest level of compliance. This position is responsible for State and Local Regulatory compliance, including the Video Franchise and PEG(Public Education Grants) filings with various Local Franchise Authorities, utilizing financial systems to analyze data, compute payments for an end-to-end compliance cycle while adhering to compliance laws and contractual agreements. This position will also encompass review of surcharge recovery, account reconciliations, projects, and other related tasks. RESPONSIBILITIES: Prepare State and Local Regulatory compliance, including Video Franchise and PEG filings, and Business Licenses in an accurate and timely manner in accordance with the applicable laws and regulations for all Verizon-owned companies. Understand the impact of new products and offers to update regulatory filings accordingly. Analyze Franchise Recovery costs and submit requests to initiate/terminate surcharges accordingly. Partner with Regulatory Legal team to review contract renewals for changes to existing payment terms and ensure implementation with the billing team. Process payments in accordance with CPS-103 controls, manage liabilities and expenses related to the filings; work with AP, Treasury, and various in-house payment systems. Participate in company initiatives, including new product launch, billing IT developments, and legal entity restructuring by communicating Regulatory compliance impacts and requirements. Assist with the accounting aspect of the Regulatory function, including review of account reconciliations, accrual journal entries, and understanding surcharge recovery and expense gaps. Prepare analysis related to mergers and acquisitions (including due diligence and computing purchase price adjustments), Budgets, Metrics, Cash Forecasting, and other monthly reports. Adhere to Sox controls, assist with related audits, billing inquiries, and resolve notices timely and accurately. Partner with Regulatory and Tax Legal teams to conduct research as needed to comply with legislative changes and implement best compliance practices. Focus on identifying process improvements and streamlining existing procedures to be effective and efficient. What we’re looking for… You’ll need to have: Bachelor’s degree or four or more years of work experience. Four or more years of relevant experience required, demonstrated through work and/or military experience. Experience in Tax, Finance, or equivalent. Experience with tax research, tax accounting, SOX processes, telecommunication taxes, and tax saving strategies. Advanced computer skills are required (Excel, Word, PowerPoint). Ability to prioritize deliverables with competing timelines. Even better if you have one or more of the following: Bachelor’s Degree in Finance or Accounting. Proficient with large volume data analysis needed for the preparation and filing of tax returns (i.e.: knowledge of billing systems, etc.). Regulatory experience. Previous exposure to SAP (or other major General Ledger Suite Software). Working knowledge of automation tools (i.e. Alteryx, Qlik, Power BI, Tableau, Gemini, Google Suite, Google App Script) and technical skills. Strong oral, written communication skills and analytical skills. If Verizon and this role sound like a fit for you, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every “even better” qualification listed above. Where you’ll be working In this hybrid role, you'll have a defined work location that includes working from home and a minimum of three days per week in the office, which will be set by your manager. Employees are responsible for maintaining compliance with hybrid work policies. Scheduled Weekly Hours 40 Equal Employment Opportunity Verizon is an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to veteran status, disability or other legally protected characteristics. Benefits and Compensation Our benefits are designed to help you move forward in your career, and in areas of your life outside of Verizon. From health and wellness benefit options including: medical, dental, vision, short and long term disability, basic life insurance, supplemental life insurance, AD&D insurance, identity theft protection, pet insurance and group home & auto insurance. We also offer a matched 401(k) savings plan, up to 8 company paid holidays per year and up to 6 personal days per year, paid parental leave, adoption assistance and tuition assistance, plus other incentives, we’ve got you covered with our award-winning total rewards package. Depending on the role, employees have the opportunity to receive compensation in the form of premium pay such as overtime, shift differential, holiday pay, allowances, etc. Newly hired employees receive up to 15 days of vacation per year, which grows with additional service. For part-timers, your coverage will vary as you may be eligible for some of these benefits depending on your individual circumstances. The salary will vary depending on your location and confirmed job-related skills and experience. This is an incentive based position with the potential to earn more. For part-time roles, your compensation will be adjusted to reflect your hours. The annual salary range for the location(s) listed on this job requisition based on a full-time schedule is: $80,500.00 - $141,000.00.

jobs.description: Here at Amazon, we embrace our differences. We are committed to furthering our culture of diversity and inclusion of our teams within the organization. How do you get items to customers quickly, cost-effectively, and—most importantly—safely, in less than an hour? And how do you do it in a way that can scale? Our teams of hundreds of scientists, engineers, aerospace professionals, and futurists have been working hard to do just that! We are delivering to customers, and are excited for what’s to come. Check out more information about Prime Air on the About Amazon blog (https://www.aboutamazon.com/news/transportation/amazon-prime-air-delivery-drone-reveal-photos). If you are seeking an iterative environment where you can drive innovation, apply state-of-the-art technologies to solve real world delivery challenges, and provide benefits to customers, Prime Air is the place for you. Come work on the Amazon Prime Air Team! We're looking for a Applied Scientist with a background in developing simulations for traffic management algorithms, including expert knowledge in strategic deconfliction, tactical deconfliction, or detect-and-avoid systems. Managing a large number of concurrent autonomous drone flights that share airspace with other autonomous or manned aircraft is a challenging problem. Be part of the team building simulation tools and algorithms to solve this at scale. This role will contribute to a portfolio of simulation tools managing concurrent airspace traffic for aviation systems. This will include developing new methodologies in the areas of conflict detection and resolution, as well as developing related software systems that will be used in operation to enable package delivery at scale. The ideal candidate is comfortable with risk-taking and ambiguity and able to build consensus on critical, controversial technical decisions. If you enjoy the process of solving real-world problems that haven’t been solved at scale anywhere before, Prime Air is right for you. Along the way, we guarantee you’ll get opportunities to be a disruptor, prolific innovator, and a reputed problem solver and directly impact Amazon’s customers worldwide. Key job responsibilities The primary focus of this role will be on modeling traffic management frameworks that use a layered conflict detection and resolution strategy to ensure safe and efficient flight operations. This will include developing fundamental simulation infrastructure code, including discrete event simulation tooling. In addition, it will involve developing expert knowledge of the layers of mitigation and conducting in-depth scientific research on alternative solutions for conflict resolution. The candidate will contribute to significant and impactful systems that will provide value for Amazon customers and will drive these projects from the concept stage through development. This role will include substantial software development in prototyping and production environments.
